envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: operator ruling held during judge-speed-plan-line: a dispatched subagent is already bounded, judged twice and supervised, so guarding it duplicates that acceptance and competes for the same judge

payload.gloss: a guard binds exactly the agents whose composition includes it, and only in such an agent’s own main session, never in a subagent it dispatches, which is bounded by what it was handed, judged by its assay and the whole check, and supervised by the main session; on every supported harness it judges every turn it fires on; where its judge cannot run, it lets the turn through and says so, never silently, and it asks the judge again once the judge may have recovered, so a passing outage never leaves the guard unjudged for the rest of a session. A judgement fits within the time its harness allows a guard, so a judge that is merely slow is never reported as one that could not run. Where a harness cannot tell which agent is running, the guard is carried as a stated rule instead and the operator is told; a guard that fires and judges nothing never ships.
